subject: Request: Temporary no-PO vendor onboarding for Borealis pilot
body:
From: Amy Li <amy.li@borealis.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Borealis Procurement <procurement@borealis.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot onboarding request — Borealis (trial, small monthly spend)

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the demo last week — team is excited to start a two-month pilot integrating Redwood for low-latency embeddings. Procurement asked me to request a temporary onboarding path: the pilot spend will be under $5k/mo and we will sign your standard MSA after the pilot. To avoid blocking kickoff next week, would Redwood consider a temporary "no-PO" path for billing during the trial?

What we can provide immediately: signed SOW (attached), W9 (attached), primary billing contact, and an estimate of monthly usage. We can accept Net30 monthly invoices. We also have one small ask: include a clause that we will transition to a PO or MSA-based procurement process before any renewal or scale.

Attachments: borealis_sow.pdf (SOW), borealis_w9.pdf (W9)

Let me know what evidence you need to get us onboarded quickly.

Best,
Amy Li
Head of Integrations
Borealis AI
amy.li@borealis.ai

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Li <amy.li@borealis.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding request — Borealis (trial, small monthly spend)

Hi Amy — thanks, and great to hear. Looping in Procurement (Markus) and Finance Ops (Naomi) to confirm an appropriate temporary onboarding path.

Markus / Naomi — Borealis is requesting a temporary no-PO route for a 2-month pilot. They attached SOW and W9, are comfortable with Net30 invoices, and will commit to transitioning to a PO/MSA before renewal. Estimated spend: ~ $3k/month.

Quick questions for procurement:
- Is the SOW + W9 sufficient evidence for a short-term allowlist?
- Do we need COI/insurance for a pilot at this spend level?
- Proposed guardrails: 60-day temporary allowlist, monthly invoices, cap at $7,500 total for the pilot unless escalated.

Amy — we'll confirm and aim to have an answer by EOD.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Sr. Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0123

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Pilot onboarding request — Borealis (procurement check)

Thanks for the context — sounds like a typical small-pilot ask. My suggested approach:

1) Evidence checklist (minimum for temporary allowlist):
   - Signed SOW (we have it)
   - Valid W9 (we have it)
   - Primary billing contact + billing entity confirmation (need Amy to confirm billing entity name and remit address)
   - Certificate of insurance (COI) only if pilot involves on-prem or sensitive data flows — otherwise optional for <$10k total.

2) Guardrails and limits:
   - Temporary allowlist period: 60 days from first invoice date.
   - Spend cap without escalation: $10,000 total. If forecasted > $10k, route to Procurement Lead for approval.
   - Invoice cadence: monthly, Net30.

3) Contracting path:
   - Billing during pilot under our temporary vendor record (no PO required).
   - Client must sign MSA or issue PO before any renewal or before cumulative spend exceeds $10k.

4) Operational notes:
   - Finance Ops (Naomi) to create temporary vendor record and billing code.
   - Sales to log deal and include follow-up task to secure MSA/PO before renewal (Ben).

If everyone is good with the above, I can approve the temporary no-PO onboarding and ask Ops to create the vendor record. Requesting Naomi to confirm she has capacity to process this in the next 24 hours.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Procurement
Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai

Hi all — quick update. Procurement approved the temporary no-PO onboarding per Markus' proposed guardrails. Finance Ops has created a temporary vendor record and billing code VND-TEMP-782.

- We will invoice monthly, Net30, capped at $10k for the pilot period.
- Please upload COI if available; otherwise we will proceed without for this pilot.
- We attached the invoice template and intake checklist for your records.

Attachments: invoice_template.xlsx (stub), onboarding_checklist.pdf (stub)

Amy — we created a HubSpot deal and a DocuSign envelope to capture the SOW signature flow; please sign the SOW so our systems are aligned. Links: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/DEAL-9382 and https://docusign.example.com/envelope/12345 (docuSign stub)

I'll route the first invoice after the first month of usage.
